resources.string: BBBot plays Block Blast on its own. It reads the screen, decides where the pieces go and drags them there.
BBBot needs its accessibility service to see the screen and to move the pieces. Switch on “BBBot” in the accessibility settings.
A small BBBot panel appears on top of Block Blast.
The choice applies the next time the bot is started.
Keeps the board open and gives up a combo early. Long games, fewer points per piece.
A middle course between long games and long combos.
Holds on to combos at the cost of the board. Most points per piece, but games end sooner.
Lets BBBot play Block Blast: it takes screenshots while the game is in front and drags the pieces onto the board. BBBot does not read the contents of other apps and sends nothing anywhere.
No room for all pieces · Moves: %1$d · Screenshot saved
